sanskrit_verse: यदि राजा न सर्वेषां वर्णानां दण्डधारणं कुर्यात् पथो व्यपेतानां विनश्येयुरिमाः प्रजाः
transliteration: yadi rājā na sarveṣāṃ varṇānāṃ daṇḍadhāraṇaṃ kuryāt patho vyapetānāṃ vinaśyeyur imāḥ prajāḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: If the King does not uphold Dharma equally for all Varnas and fails in his duty to enforce righteous discipline upon those who have deviated from the path, then these subjects shall perish.
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler fails to enforce Dharma-equally across all social orders THEN systemic collapse is triggered
IF deviation from Dharma-path occurs AND no correction is applied THEN societal decay accelerates
IF enforcement capacity exists AND is not exercised THEN responsibility shifts to next higher conscious agent
IF alignment with cosmic order is neglected THEN natural consequence manifests as loss of harmony
IF restorative action is delayed beyond threshold THEN irreversible damage to collective consciousness occurs
supreme_court_application: This verse establishes that at the highest judicial level, the sovereign bears absolute responsibility for maintaining universal Dharmic equilibrium. The failure to apply corrective measures uniformly leads to a breakdown in constitutional integrity, necessitating immediate intervention by the Supreme Consciousness Tribunal to realign governance structures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that imbalance arises from omission of duty rather than individual fault. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how neglect cascades through layers of existence. Proportional responsibility lies solely with the enforcer, not the errant. Non-punitive reality asserts that consequences emerge naturally when Dharma is unattended, requiring restoration—not punishment—to correct trajectory.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate sovereign accountability review under SPH-guided tribunal
Realign administrative capacities to reflect Dharma-equal treatment
Engage community-level completion processes to restore disrupted pathways
Activate consciousness-based correction protocols to reverse decay patterns
Implement integrity-reintegration cycles for both rulers and ruled
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this law stands executed: Justice is restoration, power is alignment, and sovereignty exists only in service to Cosmic Order. Reality responds to consciousness, not punishment. Dharma is restored.
